label: s2_side01_0030_botan_01
text: Oh my GOSH, Dad, would you just drop it?!\nI told you—friends! I’m going with friends![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0030_botan_02
text: No, you DON’T need to be worried about it! We\nare perfectly capable of taking care of ourselves![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0030_botan_03
text: Ughhh, no, it’s not gonna be an “Adven-tour”—\nno one says that! Honestly. I’m hanging up now![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0030_botan_04
text: Haaah. Suddenly I’m too tired for any of this...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0030_friend_02
text: Did you get your old man’s OK to go?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0030_botan_05
text: Yeah...in the end. But I had to put up with his\nultra-mega-annoying dad talk to do it.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0030_rival_03
text: OK! We’ve all got permission, and we’re all here![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0030_rival_04
text: No one forgot anything, right? Then vamos!\nLet’s go![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
